holdings.text: Declares the complaint under Article 8 admissible

anchor.surface_text:
FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT, UNANIMOUSLY,

1.  Declares the complaint under Article 8 admissible ...;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the complaint under Article 8 was not manifestly ill-founded and admissible under Article 35 § 3(a).

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 8 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text:
1.  Declares the complaint under Article 8 admissible ...;

2.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 8 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court balanced the applicant's right to respect for private life against freedom of expression and found the domestic courts failed to protect the applicant's image rights adequately, constituting a violation of Article 8.

holdings.text: Holds that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final in accordance with Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the sum of EUR 7,500 (seven thousand five hundred euros) in respect of pecuniary damage

anchor.surface_text:
3.  Holds

(a)  that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final in accordance with Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the sum of EUR 7,500 (seven thousand five hundred euros) in respect of pecuniary damage;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court awarded non-pecuniary damages of EUR 7,500 to the applicant for the violation of Article 8, dismissing pecuniary damage claims due to lack of causal link and evidence.

holdings.text: Holds that from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement simple interest shall be payable on the above amount at a rate equal to the marginal lending rate of the European Central Bank during the default period plus three percentage points

anchor.surface_text: (b)  that from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement simple interest shall be payable on the above amount at a rate equal to the marginal lending rate of the European Central Bank during the default period plus three percentage points;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court ordered default interest on the awarded amount at the ECB marginal lending rate plus three percentage points.

holdings.text: Dismisses the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction

anchor.surface_text: 4.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction.

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court dismissed the applicant's claims for pecuniary damage and costs due to lack of causal link and supporting evidence.

outcome.relief_summary: Violation of Article 8 found; respondent State ordered to pay applicant EUR 7,500 for non-pecuniary damage; pecuniary damage claim dismissed; remainder of just satisfaction claim dismissed.
directions: Respondent State to pay EUR 7,500 to applicant within three months from final judgment date.
Simple interest payable on the amount from expiry of three months until settlement at ECB marginal lending rate plus three percentage points.
